blocks.text: Starting Dec. 14, 2026, Meta accounts that have secondary Facebook profiles will be deleted. This is according to Meta, the parent company of Facebook, which announced the move. What is a secondary profile? A secondary profile is a second account created under the same Meta login. These accounts are personal profiles and not related to Business pages. The behavior of secondary accounts were to be used as pseudonyms or perhaps pen names to distinguish a main account from a community. These accounts will be deleted by December 14, 2026.
